notes.title: Tank Art Contest
notes.content:
Attention all Tank Mechanic Simulator VR players! Get ready to show off your creative skills in our latest Tank Art Contest. We want to see your best designs for tanks in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222244/2bd8e3983f07278ff4a72b9b455e6866e5e96643.jpg

Contest Rules:

1. Only the Tank Mechanic Simulator VR version is eligible for the contest.

2. The duration of the contest is from February 10th to February 18th, 2023.

3. Works should be uploaded (jpg, png) to either the TMS General Channel on Discord or the TMS VR Steam Page Community Hub / Screenshots. Links to these platforms can be found below.

DISCORD:
https://discord.com/channels/806804115530842132/826861586635030529
STEAM:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1463010/screenshots/

4. Each person can upload a maximum of 3 works.

5. The jury will pick the most creative work in their opinion.

6. A post with examples of what kind of screenshots would be the best can be found below.

7. Prizes:

WINNER: GameFormatic Collection including Tank Mechanic Simulator VR, Car Mechanic Simulator VR, Timberman VR, Tank Mechanic Simulator (flat version, not VR) + DLC "First Supply" and Petard Pack including Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 - Vans & Campers DLC, Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 - USA CLASSIC 60S DLC, Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 - Wheeler Dealers DLC, Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 - Hot Rod Custom Cars and a Special Discord role: Tank Artist.

SECOND PLACE: GameFormatic Collection including Tank Mechanic Simulator VR, Car Mechanic Simulator VR, Timberman VR.

THIRD PLACE: One game from GameFormatic Collection of your choice: Tank Mechanic Simulator VR, Car Mechanic Simulator VR, or Timberman VR.

8. The prizes will be awarded in the form of game keys, sent in a private message.

9. The organizer of the contest is GameFormatic.

10. Complaints can be submitted to hello@gameformatic.com

So, get your paintbrushes and imagination ready and start creating your masterpiece. We can't wait to see what you come up with!

Remember to follow our official page and keep an eye on our social media channels for more updates and announcements. Good luck, tank artists!

notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222244/de282171788975d4e2d1b4840f6eb1b129eae61d.png

Hello mechanics! 🧰 🛠️ 🎮

As you all keep playing and testing the game, we are doing our best to solve any issue you run into. Once again we would like to express how much all your feedback means to us! It already allowed us to prepare third update ✅ 👍🏽

That is why we prepared 2 forms which we believe will be helpful both for you and for us:

1. BUG REPORT FORM

2. PLAYTEST SURVEY
 
Please feel free to use them both for bugs reporting and to share your insights and suggestions with us!

And here's the list of today's changes in the Playtest:


 New Lighting system
 Improved FPS for most setups with SinglePass rendering.
 Fixed the bug causing Red Platform not appearing in come cases
 Improved Outline for elements and tools, lines are sharper now and do not overlay on each other
 Grinder tool fixes
 Test Track collisions fixed
 Game freezing in Warehouse fixed
 Using laser, Grab and Wrench Tool on Screw will not speed up the process anymore
 Fixed paintable textures on tank
 Tablet automatic hand laser is fixed for both Tablet and Keyboard
 Screw grab mechanics fixed
 Resolved issue with duplicated parts when grabbed in a specific way
 Improved switching between dissassemble and assemble modes

notes.title: Watch it! Tanks in VR are coming!
notes.content:
Homebred mechanics, historians and military fans! Grab equipment – find old, abandoned, armoured vehicles from WW II era – renovate them – paint – and collect in your own museum! You can even test those legendary machines on (dummy) battlefield! And it’s all in VR, real as much as it can be, so prepare for being sweaty and dirty during the renovation.

[previewyoutube=Qqm5JCxzTBE;full][/previewyoutube]

So, let me explain this case on that piece of junk. Can you see those mud, wet spots? It’s because I have to dig it up from the ground first. There, one of the tracks in the tank is broken. Can you see it? I have to buy a new one and replace it. Oh, and this rust all over the roof? Give me the pressure washer or sandblaster, it’s necessary before painting and all that stuff. Yup, by the way, the next steps are adding primer and final paint, then camouflage, colours and decals. Then I’ll test the beast on the battleground and put it back to the museum.

Oh, you want to do this by yourself? Sure! Grab VR goggles, search for one of a dozen legendary vehicles and take care of them!

What’s cool about the VR version?
- it’s even more immersive
- you can almost feel the pressure from the pressure washer
- you can touch anything with your own hands
- you can feel the weight of parts and tools
- didn’t I tell you about the ability to enter the tank, navigate it and shoot from the tank tube?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1463010/Tank_Mechanic_Simulator_VR/

All right, but first things first – add Tank Mechanic Simulator VR to your wishlist. Then wait until 3Q2021, OK? Meanwhile, join our Discord and follow our social media to learn more.

Now clean up your area, you’ll need some space for keeping there your own tanks!
